## You will be able to

- Build personal AI workflows for email
- documents
- meetings and research
- Use enterprise assistants (Copilot / Claude / Gemini) inside daily tools

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_meeting_to_followups.py` | 1 | 15 | owner/action/date extraction from a transcript, the gaps it refuses to guess, and one follow-up per owner |
| 2 | `02_notes_to_report.py` | 2 | 15 | schema-driven extraction into a report table, then a verification pass that traces each figure back to the notes |
| 3 | `03_vendor_comparison.py` | 3 | 12 | a weighted decision matrix with sourced scores, and a test of whether the winner survives a change of weights |
| 4 | `04_prompt_library.py` | 4 | 10 | five saved prompts checked against the four-part standard (role, input, format, check) with a quality score |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
